faq.q: Which package should I start with?
faq.a: If you are starting out or testing the market, Starter puts you online in a week. If you already have customers and want the site to bring in and track inquiries, start with Launch. If you upgrade from Starter within 6 months, what you paid counts as credit.

faq.q: What do we get back from investing in a website?
faq.a: A website designed from scratch around your customers, in two languages, set up to be found on Google, and tracking every form and chat enquiry, so you can see exactly how many customers it brings in. No monthly platform fees, and it's built to last for years.
Yes. You get the source code, the domain stays in your name and all accounts are handed over at launch.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: Your services and prices, photos, logo and a few details about your customers. I send a simple checklist in week 1.

faq.q: Can it work with our booking or shop system?
faq.a: Usually yes. Most booking and payment tools can be linked or embedded. I check yours on the first call.

faq.q: Why is it a fixed price?
faq.a: Because the scope is fixed. You know the cost and the launch date before we start, and anything new is quoted separately first.

Founder.meta_description: Command & Palette is a one-person studio in Bangkok. Meet Bobby, who plans, designs and builds every website himself.
Founder.hero_subtitle: Founder of Command & Palette, based in Bangkok. 15+ years in business development, and I write the code myself. I can talk about your customers and your numbers, then build the website.
Founder.name: Bobby
story: When I book a restaurant, a hotel or a treatment in Thailand, I do what everyone does: find the place on Google Maps, read the reviews, then tap through to the website. Very often there isn't one. And when there is, it's slow, broken on a phone, or looks like it hasn't been touched in fifteen years.

Thai businesses are great at Facebook, LINE and Instagram. But most don't own a website that brings customers to them directly, so they rely on marketplaces and give away margin and customer relationships they should keep.

I saw a clear gap: very few studios build fast, modern websites for these businesses and care whether those sites actually bring in customers. Command & Palette is how I'm closing that gap, one business at a time.
background: 15+ years in business development and partnerships across telecom, eCommerce, hospitality tech and online platforms.
Led a team of seven that brought 550+ premium beauty and wellness businesses onto a booking platform in six months.
Worked with 250+ corporate clients and ran nationwide operations handling 100,000+ orders a month.
Ran SEO and digital campaigns for luxury hospitality clients that lifted booking rates by 24%.
Designed, built and launched Kado, a Chrome extension, entirely on my own.
Engineering degree (international program) and a Junior MBA from Chulalongkorn University.
Languages: Thai, English, Japanese (conversational), Mandarin Chinese (basic).
